'''2009 Bespin Regionals George Garrelts LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[George Garrelts]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)|OVS8-05-Careful_Planning-remaster.webp|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
